name: Elena Rodriguez
discretionary_target: Surface the split shipment detail and explain both ETAs proactively

turns.text: Hi there, I placed an order a few days ago and wanted to see how it's going.
Sure, my customer ID is CUST-005.
Yes, that's correct. The order number is ORD-5001.
Oh, it was split into two shipments? I didn't realize that. So part one is already here but part two is still on the way?
Okay, got it. Do you know when I can expect the second part to arrive?
Thanks so much for checking on that for me. I really appreciate the help!
